newNode->next = head;    // Step 1: Link new node to head node

# SOLVE UI/UX DEVELOPER HANDOFF SPECIFICATION **Version:** 2.4-Production-Handoff **Date:** March 2025 **Product:** SOLVE — Personalised Conversational AI Learning Mentor **Design System:** Monochrome Cognition (Light Mode Only) **Status:** Ready for Engineering Implementation & Sprint Planning --- ## EXECUTIVE SUMMARY & ARCHITECTURAL CONTRACT SOLVE is a high-rigour, socratic conversational AI learning mentor built on strict epistemic grounding. The application architecture is fundamentally divided into two operational workspaces: 1. **Chat Mode:** Scoped for immediate learning tasks, ad-hoc concept breakdowns, quick queries, and bounded, time-limited exam preparation (e.g. *Data Structures mid preparation*). 2. **Study Mode:** Scoped exclusively for long-term capability building, multi-month structured goals (e.g. *Python foundations — 3 Month Track*), milestone tracking, and spaced revision. ### Non-Negotiable Product Rules (System Invariants) - **Strict Data Isolation:** Chat and Study workspaces share identical pedagogical capabilities (explanations, resources, practice, teach-back, and feedback), but their histories, drafts, uploaded resources, learning plans, Knowledge Graph nodes, and Target Status metrics **must never be merged or crossed**. - **Context Preservation:** Switching between Chat and Study preserves the active thread, open task, viewport state, and unsent composer draft independently in each mode. - **Account-Wide Boundaries:** User Profile (name, age, education level, field of study) and Global Preferences (interface language, explanation language, explanation detail, audio speed, reduced motion, text size) are shared across the account and do not reset when switching modes. - **Verifiable Evidence Contract (No Hallucinated Progress):** Knowledge Graph nodes and Target Status metrics increment **only upon verifiable learner actions** (e.g., successful diagnostic check, answered practice item, evaluated teach-back). No pass-probability percentages, peer comparisons, or fabricated mastery scores are permitted. Breaks are never counted as demonstrated learning. --- ## SECTION A: SCREEN INVENTORY & ROUTING MATRIX All 13 logical screen groups created across Prompts 1–16 are indexed below with their operational boundaries, entry points, interaction targets, and implementation status. | Group # | Screen Name & Primary Purpose | Mode | Entry Points | Primary / Secondary Actions | Destination / Visible Result | Return / Back Behavior | Desktop Asset | Mobile Asset | Status | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **01** | **Welcome & Sign-In**

All styling is deterministic and adheres to an 8px base grid rhythm with 4px micro-adjustments. ### 1. Left pill secondary. - *Focus-Visible:* `outline: 2px solid #111111; outline-offset: 2px;` - **Behavior:** Toggling triggers instantaneous swap of sidebar history, search scope, active plan, Knowledge Graph nodes, and Target Status records without full-page reloads. #### 2. Multiline Message Composer - **Visual Design:** Floating pill/card with interior auto-expanding `textarea`, attachment button (`+`), voice dictation button (mic), and solid circle submit button (`↑`). - **States:** - *Empty:* Placeholder *"Ask follow-up or challenge thesis..."*, submit button disabled (`opacity-30 cursor-not-allowed`). - *Active / Typing:* Submit button enabled (`bg-[#111111] text-white`). - *Voice Recording:* Pulsing recording indicator, waveform representation, *"Listening..."* label, cancel (`✕`) action. - *Streaming Generation:* Stop button (`■`) displayed; composer temporarily disables new input. #### 3. Cognitive Knowledge Graph Node - **Visual Design:** Pill-shaped vector node with concept title and semantic status dot. - **States:** - *Planned (No Activity):* Subtle dashed border `#e5e5e5`, text `#8e8e8e`. - *Explored:* Solid border `#e5e5e5`, text `#111111`, small book icon. - *Practised:* Solid border `#111111`, filled indicator, tick icon. - *Needs Review:* Border `#fadcd9`, background `#fff8f8`, red exclamation icon `!`, label *"Needs review"*. - *Selected:* 2px solid outline `#111111`, focus ring, opens inspector panel. --- ## SECTION D: INTERACTION & NAVIGATION SPECIFICATION | User Action | Trigger / Event | Visible System Response | State & Context Preserved | Fallback / Recovery Behavior | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **New Chat** | Click `+ New chat` in sidebar | Clears message canvas; displays empty state with prompt chips; sets focus to composer. | Previous thread is automatically saved and committed to Chat History. | If unsent draft exists in old thread, it remains cached for when user re-opens it. | | **New Study Goal** | Click `+ New study goal` in Study mode | Displays 3-question intake modal (Target capability, starting comfort, weekly time). | Current active study goal progress remains untouched in backend. | Modal cancel button closes overlay and restores previous active goal view. | | **Workspace Mode Switch** | Toggle Chat/Study segmented control | Immediate view swap. Your recent profile edits haven't been saved."* | Form state remains held in memory while modal is active. | User selects *Keep editing* (focus returns to form) or *Discard changes* (routes away). | --- ## SECTION E: RESPONSIVE ADAPTATION & ACCESSIBILITY SPECIFICATION ### 1. Viewport Breakpoints & Structural Reflow - **Desktop (>= 1024px):** - Persistent left sidebar (`260px` fixed width). - Main content container capped at `1000px` max-width with auto centering. - Two-column layouts for Settings and Task Assessment. - Multi-column bar charts and horizontal progress indicators. - **Tablet (768px – 1023px):** - Sidebar collapses to compact icon-rail or off-canvas drawer triggered by hamburger `☰`. - Content max-width `100%` with `24px` horizontal padding. - **Mobile (< 768px, target 390px × 844px):** - Left sidebar converts entirely to sliding Navigation Drawer (`left: 0; width: 85%`). - Fixed Top App Bar with back navigation, screen title, and mode indicators. - Fixed Bottom Navigation Bar (`h-16 bg-white border-t border-[#e5e5e5]`) with 5 primary destinations: **Mentor (Chat/Study)**, **Plan**, **Graph**, **Status**, **Settings**. - All multi-column cards stack vertically in natural DOM flow. - Horizontal page scrolling is strictly forbidden (`overflow-x: hidden`). Internal horizontal widgets (e.g. filter chips, code blocks) scroll within self-contained scroll containers (`overflow-x: auto; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;`). - Interactive touch targets strictly enforce minimum `44px × 44px` physical dimensions. - Keyboard avoidance: On mobile focus of the composer, the bottom tab bar hides, and the composer anchors above the virtual keyboard viewport (`interactive-widget=resizes-content`). ### 2. Accessibility Engineering (WCAG 2.1 AA Compliance) - **Contrast Ratios:** - Primary text (`#111111`) on canvas (`#ffffff`): **16.5:1** (Exceeds AAA requirement). - Secondary text (`#616161`) on canvas (`#ffffff`): **4.6:1** (Exceeds AA standard 4.5:1). - Borders (`#e5e5e5`) on canvas: Standard non-text contrast for component boundaries. - **Focus Order & Visual Focus Rings:** - Strict logical keyboard tab order following DOM reading structure. - All interactive elements must implement high-visibility focus indicators: `outline: 2px solid #111111; outline-offset: 2px;`. Never use `outline: none` without a custom replacement. - **Dialog & Drawer Focus Trapping:** - Opening the Search Dialog (`Cmd+K`) or Attempt Review Drawer traps keyboard focus within the container. - Pressing `ESC` closes the container and returns focus directly to the initiating trigger element. - **Screen Reader Announcements (`aria-live`):** - Voice recording status: `aria-live="polite"` announcing *"Microphone active. Listening..."*. - Streaming LLM output: Announcements silenced during streaming; `aria-live="polite"` announces *"Response complete"* once generation finishes. - Target Status sync: `aria-live="assertive"` for sync error notifications. - **Non-Color Dependent Semantics:** - Every status condition must couple color with explicit iconography and text labels: - `Needs review`: Red outline + Alert triangle icon `!` + Text label *"Needs review"*. - `Completed`: Green accent + Checkmark icon `✓` + Text label *"Completed"*. - **Motion Accessibility:** - When `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` is detected, all smooth scrolls, fade-ins, and animated SVGs are disabled (`animation: none !important; transition: none !important;`). --- ## SECTION F: EDGE CASES, EMPTY STATES & RESILIENCE MATRIX | Scenario | Trigger / Condition | UI Representation | Available User Action | Prohibited Behavior | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **First-Time User (Empty Chat)** | New account, 0 conversations | Quiet centered prompt with SOLVE glyph, headline *"What would you like to explore?"*, and 3 socratic prompt chips. | Click prompt chip or type in composer. | Never display an intimidating blank gray void or system debug strings. | | **Empty Study Goals** | User navigates to Study mode with no active goals | Hero card: *"Your long-term study roadmap begins here.
